visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a nighttime view of a high-end swimming pool deck bathed in vibrant neon purple and blue lighting. A text box at the top provides context. The camera tilts downward toward the water. (2) Two young women in bikinis emerge in the pool, facing the camera in a selfie-style shot. One has black hair and a black bikini, the other has light brown hair and a silver bikini. They wave and smile broadly. (3) An overhead wide shot captures the two women swimming and raising their arms in the glowing blue pool water. Tiered cabanas and luxury seating with bright architectural lighting are visible in the background. (4) The camera zooms out significantly to reveal the entire pool complex under a dark night sky, highlighting the scale of the venue. (5) The shot returns to a close-up selfie perspective where both women look into the camera, laughing and playfully sticking out their tongues while wading in the pool.
